chronology.1_sequence_universe_and_split_rule: the MOT20 sequence universe (MOT20-01/02/03/05) and the second-half split rule were frozen in 02_PROSPECTIVE_PROTOCOL BEFORE any MOT17 execution.
chronology.2_evaluator_native_semantics: MOT20 evaluator-native GT semantics (09A) were completed AFTER MOT17 outcomes were known but BEFORE any MOT20 outcome existed.

chronology.wording_prohibition: this selection must NOT be described as a prospectively selected winner, nor as outcome-based selection, nor as a best-performing method.
